title: TIDE: Proactive Multi-Problem Discovery via Template-Guided Iteration
abstract: arXiv:2606.04743v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Agents are widely deployed as assistants over documents, tools, and code. However, they typically act only on explicit user requests, which surface only the problems the user has noticed, while many other important problems coexist, hidden in plain sight, within the broader user context, with their total number unknown in advance. We frame this as the task of discovering multiple hidden problems from context, in which coexisting problems should be uncovered, grounded in supporting evidence, and paired with concrete actions. To this end, we introduce TIDE, a template-guided iterative framework with two complementary mechanisms. Specifically, motivated by the observation that single-pass prediction anchors on the most salient cases and yields generic claims, we propose iterative discovery, which surfaces a small batch of candidates per round while conditioning on what has already been found, so subsequent rounds extend coverage;

translated_title: TIDE：通过模板引导迭代实现主动多问题发现
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2606.04743v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：代理（Agents）广泛部署于文档、工具和代码的辅助任务中。然而，它们通常仅响应用户的显式请求，这只能揭示用户已注意到的问题，而许多其他重要问题则隐藏于更广泛的用户上下文中，数量未知且显而易见。我们将此任务定义为从上下文中发现多个隐藏问题，其中需要揭示共存问题、基于支持证据，并配以具体行动。为此，我们引入了TIDE，一种模板引导的迭代框架，包含两种互补机制。具体而言，鉴于单次预测往往聚焦于最显著案例并产生泛化性结论的观察，我们提出了迭代发现机制，每轮仅暴露一小批候选，同时基于已发现内容进行条件化处理，从而后续轮次扩展覆盖范围；
tldr: TIDE提出了一种模板引导的迭代框架，通过分轮发现隐藏问题并基于已有发现扩展覆盖，从而主动揭示上下文中多个共存且数量未知的问题。
en_tdlr: TIDE proposes a template-guided iterative framework that discovers hidden problems in batches per round while conditioning on prior findings, enabling proactive identification of multiple coexisting issues with unknown total count in context.
